description:

Neutral décor throughout with high quality fixtures and fittings means the spacious master suite feels luxurious. You’ll enjoy those great sea views again and again each day as you wake up to enjoy another day living the much-loved Costa del Sol lifestyle.

Resort style living means this stunning gated community benefits from a gym, heated indoor pool and outdoors pools to enjoy. Offering the ultimate in modern living, these luxury Benahavis apartments are set to be in high demand, so talk to us today to reserve your favourite unit.
